import Algebra.BigOperators
import Data.Nat.Prime
import RingTheory.Ideal.AbsoluteNorm
import RingTheory.DedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum

open Ideal

theorem lg_target {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R) [Module.Finite ℤ R] [Module.Free ℤ R] : 1 < Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal := by
  let ⟨p, hp⟩ := v
  have h_nonzero : p ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_is_prime hp
  have h_prime : IsPrime p := hp
  have h_norm_ge_2 : 1 < Ideal.absNorm p := by
    let k := p.quotient
    let k' := k.toFiniteField
    let l := k'.order
    have h_l_pos : 0 < l := by apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero; exact ne_zero_of_nontrivial k'.toFiniteField
    have h_l_ge_2 : l ≥ 2 := by
      let h_k_card_ne_1 : Cardinal.mk k ≠ 1 := ne_zero_of_nontrivial k'.toFiniteField
      let h_k_card_eq_l : Cardinal.mk k = l := by exact k'.toFiniteField.card_eq
      let h_l_ge_2 : l ≥ 2 :=
        let h_k_card_ne_1 : Cardinal.mk k ≠ 1 := h_k_card_ne_1
        let h_k_card_eq_l : Cardinal.mk k = l := h_k_card_eq_l
        let h_l_ge_2 : l ≥ 2 := by
          rcases eq_or_lt l 1 with (H | H)
          · contradiction H h_l_pos
          · exact lt_trans H h_l_pos
      exact h_l_ge_2
    exact lt_trans h_l_pos h_l_ge_2
  exact h_norm_ge_2
